findings.description: ActionContracts (tma_write/tma_api/tma canonical shape) with no Approvals projection
Approvals rows whose action_contract_id has no matching ActionContract
action_contract_id values with more than one Approvals projection row
Approvals projected_lifecycle_status differs from the canonical contract's status
Contract-linked Approvals rows with non-empty CONTEXT_DATA (must always be blank)
Approvals rows with a contract link but legacy_read_only=true (contradictory state)
Approvals rows with no action_contract_id that are not marked legacy_read_only=true
Approvals rows whose linked contract is not a canonical tma_write/tma_api contract
Contract-linked Approvals rows whose canonical contract's tenant_id does not match the expected rollout tenant ('boss_hq')
ActionContracts sharing a business_action_fingerprint but disagreeing with each other on tenant_id (independent of R10's single-rollout-tenant check)
Approvals rows still showing projected_lifecycle_status=pending while the canonical contract has already reached a terminal status
Claims with status=outcome_unknown, or status=executing for over 3600s (never auto-retry — investigate manually)
PostgreSQL claims whose canonical ActionContract cannot be found
ActionContracts with status=completed/executed whose PostgreSQL claim exists but disagrees (claim status != completed)
Completed/executed canonical tma_write ActionContracts with no PostgreSQL claim at all (blocking — historical tolerance for a missing claim is preserved only for non-TMA contracts)
Multiple contracts sharing a business_action_fingerprint each holding an active (executing) PostgreSQL claim at the same time
